nodes.title: Help people build self-sustaining software systems without having held every startup role
nodes.description: A system is self-sustaining when it has a stated real-world effect, a way to measure it, and a loop that keeps improving it.

nodes.title: Bropilot turns a hazy idea into a committed representation that an agent team can act on. You answer structured questions; each answer stages effects on a knowledge graph; you commit; agents build, deploy and measure; reality feeds back. Built to describe itself.
